steps.text: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
Want to come straight here?
Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
I'll have the table cleared for your notes
My very exclusive rehearsal venue
One seat. Very selective audience
At least the audience already likes me
Very much
Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
I can manage both
I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
We'll try it out when you get here
And I'll finally collect my other bag
By bringing another one?
A bag full of notes. They're different categories
Of course. I should have realised
Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
I'll put the old one by the door
Thanks, love. I need to go now
See you tonight ❤️
